source.prompt: Deep house song, about 3.5 minutes, 119 BPM, E minor. Smoky, late-night and intimate, a warm after-hours glow by the sea. Sultry, husky female lead vocal, close and breathy in the verses, opening up on the chorus with soft stacked harmonies. Rhodes electric piano chords, walking upright bass, muted guitar plucks, airy string pad, light congas and shaker. Four-on-the-floor kick, offbeat open hats, soft claps on 2 and 4, rolling shuffled percussion. Structure: instrumental intro (16 bars), verse, pre-chorus, chorus, short instrumental break, verse 2, chorus, stripped bridge with vocal and Rhodes, final chorus, instrumental outro that fades. Clean, wide mix with a tight mono low end.
source.lyrics:
[Intro]
Mm, mm

[Verse]
Lamps are low along the harbour wall
Your coat is on the hook, we never left at all
The radio is humming something slow
And every word we needed, we already know

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't fill the space, don't say a thing
Just let the evening do the talking

[Chorus]
Hold the quiet, hold it close
Where the warm night overflows
Every heartbeat, soft and low
Hold the quiet, don't let go

[Verse]
Candle on the table burning thin
Salt is on the window, let the breeze come in
Your shoulder is the only place I rest
The city's out there spinning, we don't need the rest

[Pre-Chorus]
Don't fill the space, don't say a thing
Just let the evening do the talking

[Chorus]
Hold the quiet, hold it close
Where the warm night overflows
Every heartbeat, soft and low
Hold the quiet, don't let go

[Bridge]
Ooh, the hush between us
Ooh, the hush between us
Say nothing, stay with me

[Chorus]
Hold the quiet, hold it close
Where the warm night overflows
